cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says that no password hashing decision is currently recorded and names no algorithm.

Muninn has no decision on hashing in its catalog, and `muninn why` reported the records as insufficient. The only mentions are two unverified, trust-1 session excerpts that conflict: one says bcrypt, and a later one says argon2id. Neither is a recorded decision, so I left both out of the file.

If you want a value in the policy, tell me which algorithm and I'll update the file.
